item.description:
Mimo 0.1.5

English
- Ordinary app updates now reuse Enhanced Service authorization when the service code, security properties and signing identity are unchanged.
- Kept native signature, user identity, file permission and integrity checks.
- Unified policy group type names as select, url-test, fallback and load-balance in both languages, and removed decorative type-picker icons.
- Existing Enhanced Service installations require one administrator authorization to migrate to this mechanism when next used.

简体中文
- 优化增强服务授权流程：服务代码、安全属性和签名身份未变化时，普通应用更新复用已有授权。
- 保留原生签名、用户身份、文件权限和完整性校验。
- 策略组类型在中英文界面统一使用 select、url-test、fallback、load-balance，并移除类型菜单的装饰图标。
- 已安装的增强服务下次使用时仍需授权一次，以迁移到新的授权机制。

Mimo 0.1.4

English
- Added Simplified Chinese and English UI localization, following the system language.
- Localized the main app, menu bar, Remote Controller, dialogs, help and error messages.
- Improved English layouts and singular/plural forms for counts.
- Preserved saved profile and node names, configuration values and traffic history.

简体中文
- 新增简体中文和英文界面，默认跟随系统语言。
- 覆盖主应用、菜单栏、远程控制器、弹窗、帮助与错误提示。
- 优化英文布局和数量单复数显示。
- 保留已保存的配置与节点名称、配置值及流量历史。
